## Summary

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] Benchmark impact considered, if heuristics changed

## Review Notes

- [ ] No new overclaims about TF-IDF, legal authority, factual authority, or scientific validation
- [ ] New CLI-facing Python code uses Rich output rather than bare `print()`
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include tests or documented rationale
